module ex-device {
  yang-version 1.1;
  namespace "urn:example:ex-device";
  prefix exd;
  import ex-types { prefix ext; }
  import ietf-yang-types { prefix yang; }
  include ex-device-sub;
  description
    "A device for the yang2pack tests, written for them.

     Copyright (c) 2026 the test authors.  All rights reserved.
     Redistribution is permitted under the Simplified BSD License
     (an example statement).";

  grouping port-config {
    leaf name { type string; }
    leaf mtu {
      type uint16 { range "68..9216"; }
    }
    leaf enabled { type boolean; }
  }

  grouping port-state {
    container counters {
      leaf in-octets { type yang:counter64; }
    }
  }

  container device {
    container clock {
      leaf now { type yang:date-and-time; }
    }
    leaf serial { type string; }
    leaf load { type ext:percent; }
    leaf ratio {
      type decimal64 { fraction-digits 2; }
    }
    leaf mode {
      type enumeration {
        enum "auto";
        enum 'manual';
      }
    }
    leaf kind {
      type identityref { base ext:kind; }
    }
    leaf maintenance { type empty; }
    leaf vlan {
      type union {
        type uint16;
        type string;
      }
    }
    leaf peer-serial {
      type leafref { path "/exd:device/exd:serial"; }
    }
    leaf-list tags { type string; }
    choice power {
      case mains {
        leaf volts { type int32; }
      }
      leaf battery-pct { type ext:percent; }
    }
    anydata extra;
    uses sub-stats;
    list port {
      key "name";
      leaf name {
        type leafref { path "../config/name"; }
      }
      container config { uses port-config; }
      container state {
        uses port-config;
        uses port-state {
          augment "counters" {
            leaf drops { type uint32; }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  rpc reboot {
    input { leaf delay { type uint32; } }
  }
}
